pages.title: Köch: The Road to Iyık Janyl · Kuble Soft
pages.ogTitle: Köch: The Road to Iyık Janyl (MS-DOS, 1990)
pages.description: Kuble Soft's 1990 caravan game for MS-DOS. Lead your family from the Chu to Iyık Janyl in 1877, hunt with your eagle and raft the Naryn. Free to play.
pages.imageAlt: Title screen of Köch for MS-DOS: snow-capped mountains, a horse caravan and the Pole Star in 16-colour EGA.

ld.name: Köch: The Road to Iyık Janyl
ld.description: A caravan game set in 1877. Lead a family of five 690 versts by horse caravan from the Chu to Iyık Janyl.

pages.title: Köch for the Apple II (1985) · Kuble Soft
pages.description: Köch for the Apple II, published in Chicago in 1985 by the Iradi American Association. Hi-res pictures, eagle hunting and a self-booting disk. Freeware.
pages.imageAlt: Title screen of Köch for the Apple II in hi-res colour, with mountains, the Pole Star and a horse caravan.

ld.name: Köch: The Road to Iyık Janyl (Apple II edition)

pages.title: Köch for the Commodore 64 (1983) · Kuble Soft
pages.description: The first Köch sold to the public: the Iradi American Association's 1983 mail-order disk for the Commodore 64, typed in from the 1979 listing. Freeware.
pages.imageAlt: Title screen of Köch for the Commodore 64: yellow and white text on a black screen.

ld.name: Köch: The Road to Iyık Janyl (Commodore 64 edition)

pages.title: About Kuble Soft · Talas, 1988–2007
pages.description: Kuble Soft of Talas made games and school programs from 1988 to 2007. Our history, our games, the founder's letter and free downloads of Köch.
pages.imageAlt: The Kuble Soft logo, a white star in a gold ring, beside the title screen of Köch.

ld.name: Kuble Soft
ld.description: Software company in Talas that made computer games and school programs from 1988 to 2007.
